changes.text: 魏国公子（下称公子）的姐姐，是赵国平原君（赵惠文王之弟）的夫人。魏安釐王二十年，秦军击破赵长平军之后，进兵围住邯郸。魏王派将军晋鄙带十万众救赵。秦王随即遣使警告魏王：攻赵旦暮可下，诸侯有敢救赵的，拔赵之后必先移兵击之。魏王恐惧，派人叫晋鄙停军，驻扎在邺，「名為救趙，實持兩端以觀望」。平原君的使者冠盖相属，赶到魏国，责让公子：平原君说，自己之所以与公子结为婚姻，是看重公子的高义，以为公子能急人之困；如今邯郸旦暮之间就要降秦，而魏国的救兵至今不到，公子能急人之困又在哪里？末了还添一句「獨不憐公子姊邪」。难处在于：救兵听命于魏王，而魏王畏秦，按兵不动。

The Wei prince's elder sister was the wife of Lord Pingyuan of Zhao (younger brother of King Huiwen of Zhao). In the twentieth year of King Anxi of Wei, after Qin had broken Zhao's army at Changping, its armies pressed on and encircled Handan. The king of Wei sent General Jin Bi with a hundred thousand troops to relieve Zhao. The king of Qin then sent an envoy to warn the king of Wei that Zhao would fall any day, and that whichever of the lords dared to relieve it, Qin would turn its troops on first once Zhao was taken. The king of Wei, afraid, sent orders halting Jin Bi, who encamped at Ye — nominally relieving Zhao, in fact keeping a foot in both camps and waiting to see. Lord Pingyuan's envoys arrived in Wei one after another — caps of office and carriage canopies in an unbroken line — reproaching the prince: Lord Pingyuan said he had joined himself to the prince by marriage because he valued the prince's high sense of duty and believed him a man who would rush to others in distress; now Handan was within days of surrendering to Qin, and Wei's relief still had not come — where, then, was that readiness to rush to others in distress? They added, in translation: had he no pity for his own sister? The difficulty: the relief army answered to the king of Wei, and the king, fearing Qin, kept it standing still.
侯生后来把话说穿：他故意让公子的车骑久立市中，自己去拜访一位客人，借此观察公子，公子愈恭，于是「市人皆以嬴為小人，而以公子為長者能下士也」。他还推荐过一位屠者朱亥，说「此子賢者，世莫能知」。公子几次登门去请，朱亥不回谢，公子当时只觉得奇怪。作者认为，这些看似闲棋的往来，邯郸被围那年全用上了。

Hou Ying later spelled out the game he had been playing. He had deliberately kept the prince's carriage standing in the marketplace while he called on an acquaintance of his, so as to watch the prince: the longer the prince waited, the more deferential he became — and so, he said in translation, the townsfolk all took Hou Ying for a petty man, and the prince for a true elder who could humble himself before men of talent. He also recommended a butcher named Zhu Hai, calling him, in translation, a worthy man whom the world did not know. The prince called on Zhu Hai several times; the butcher never came to return the courtesies, which the prince at that point simply found odd. In the author's view, all of these seemingly idle moves came due in the year Handan was besieged.

计策只管前半，后半是坏情况。侯生提醒「將在外，主令有所不受」：就算合符成功，晋鄙不交兵权、再向魏王请示，事情就危险了。带上屠者朱亥，「晉鄙聽，大善；不聽，可使擊之」。公子听完流泪，说「晉鄙嚄唶宿將，往恐不聽，必當殺之，是以泣耳，豈畏死哉」——照他自己的说法，哭的是非杀晋鄙不可，不是怕死。朱亥说自己是市井鼓刀屠者，从前不回谢是以为小礼无所用，「今公子有急，此乃臣效命之秋也」。侯生此前已说过老臣不能从，这里只请数着公子的行程，到晋鄙军那天「北鄉自剄，以送公子」。后来公子到了军中，「侯生果北鄉自剄」。

The plan covered only the first half; the second half was the bad case. Hou Ying warned, in translation, that a general in the field does not accept every order from his sovereign: even with the tallies matching, if Jin Bi withheld the army and sent to the king instead, the whole enterprise would be in danger. So take the butcher Zhu Hai along: if Jin Bi obeyed, excellent; if not, Zhu Hai could be made to strike him. The prince wept on hearing it; in translation, he said Jin Bi was a battle-seasoned old general who he feared would not obey, and then he would have to be killed — that was why he wept, not because he feared death. By his own account, he wept over having to kill Jin Bi, not out of fear for himself. Zhu Hai said he was a butcher who wielded the knife in the marketplace; he had never returned the prince's visits because he thought petty courtesies were of no use — but now that the prince was in need, this was his moment to give his life. Hou Ying, who had already said at the gate that he could not follow, here only asked to count the days of the journey, so that on the day the prince reached Jin Bi's camp he would face north and cut his own throat, to see him off. When the prince did reach the army, Hou Ying did indeed face north and cut his own throat.

dispositions.rationale: 中英文都调整了段落顺序，开头先交代公子的姐姐是平原君夫人，主角和使者为何找他由此立住。之后依次写秦围邯郸、晋鄙奉命救赵、魏王令晋鄙停军于邺、使者责让公子。原有事实一项未删，也未新增内容。段末那句关于公子姐姐的重复交代已删去，英文同步处理。

evidence.quote: 公子姊為趙惠文王弟平原君夫人

dispositions.rationale: 「過客」的“過”是拜访之意，同篇「臣所過屠者朱亥」也是这种用法。观察公子的人是侯生，不是路人。中文改为“自己去拜访一位客人，借此观察公子”，英文同步改为 called on an acquaintance of his, so as to watch the prince。市人如何看待二人的那句保持不变。

evidence.quote: 故久立公子車騎市中，過客以觀公子，公子愈恭

dispositions.rationale: 原句用叙述者口吻把哭因写成了定论，现改为公子本人的说法：中文为“照他自己的说法，哭的是非杀晋鄙不可，不是怕死”，英文为 By his own account...，两种语言一致。
